basics.name: Aditya Rajesh Sawant
basics.label: Software Development Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer who has shipped fault-tolerant data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and front-end systems at scale, from a 10-worker grant-ingestion pipeline to a design system serving 80M+ monthly users.

work.name: SUNY Research Foundation, CUBS Lab (Prof. Srirangaraj Setlur)
highlights: Built a fault-tolerant data ingestion pipeline scraping 3 federal grant sources (NIH, grants.gov, PCORI) with a 10-worker async Python architecture that self-throttles to avoid overloading target sites.
Designed 3 pluggable source parsers behind a common interface with bounded back-pressure queues, keeping the 10-worker pool from overrunning downstream writes.
Recovered funding fields on 100% of grant pages that single-call extraction missed, via an LLM pipeline (strict JSON schemas) splitting each page into 4 targeted extraction tasks.
Achieved zero data loss end-to-end via failure-only persistence and retry-with-backoff, upserting deduplicated records into an 8-table MySQL schema.

Eliminated a cluster-internal auth-bypass by re-architecting Apache/Shibboleth SSO and Flask into a single-pod OpenShift sidecar (loopback-bound app, exec health probes, Secret-backed creds), making the API kernel-level unreachable except through SAML SSO.

work.name: Channel Core
highlights: Kept 500+ records synced daily with zero manual intervention by integrating 6 social platforms (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, X) via OAuth with automatic token refresh and credential rotation.

Building production infrastructure serving 150+ creators: architecting isolated dev/prod cloud environments on Neon with automated S3 backups and branch protection, eliminating risk of dev changes affecting live users

work.name: Safety Knights
highlights: Architected and shipped a production EHS job board currently in beta with 4,000 users, spanning an Express/Node.js API (75+ endpoints, AES-256 encryption), an Angular v17 SSR consumer app, and a standalone admin console, a service-oriented architecture across 3 independently deployable codebases.

Designed the data layer with 4 Mongoose models using compound, geospatial, and full-text indexes, automating hourly listing expiration via node-cron to keep job data fresh without manual intervention.
Built a full candidate pipeline with GridFS document storage, 5-stage status tracking, 3 automated email flows, and multi-axis job search.

work.name: CarWale [CarTrade Tech]
highlights: Engineered and maintained the 'Oxygen Design System', a core library of 70+ reusable components in React and React Native powering front-end applications for 80 million monthly users, achieving a 10% bundle-size reduction on critical pages via a new counter-based hashing system.
Led the architectural design of a dark theme for 60+ React Native components, using React Context and custom hooks to achieve seamless, no-reload theme switching.
Cut a two-week estimate to 2 days by leveraging AI-driven automation and prompt engineering to update 250+ files.

projects.name: bro-cli
projects.description: Cross-shell CLI alias manager preserving shell state (cd, env activation) across invocations (github.com/AdityaSawant0912/bro-cli)
highlights: Built single-binary Rust CLI (bash/zsh/fish/PowerShell/cmd) that emits shell code for the wrapper to eval, letting stored aliases mutate the live shell: cd, export, venv activation persist across runs.

projects.name: Beacon
projects.description: Real-time location-sharing application with granular permission controls
highlights: Designed a permission management system handling 4 distinct relationship states, giving users granular control over who can view their live location.

Engineered a Unified Native-Web Bridge enabling a WebView-based UI to control native background services and retrieve real-time diagnostics, replacing a fully native solution with a web-based app for faster iteration.
